name: devflow
description: Issue to pull request as Archon runs: devflow-refine writes an issue's design (at most two question rounds), devflow-plan publishes its plan, test plan and the parallel build workflow build-issue-<n>, and the build implements, reviews, runs the definition of done and opens one PR watched until a person merges it; every file follows a template and one mechanical validator, and the issue carries one devflow comment. Plus quick edits, docs review, security audit, a read-only repository configuration review (file fixes through a PR, settings gaps listed for the admin's gh-baseline) and Dependabot repair.
